lines.japanese: 「あ、山科さん、おれも手伝うよ」
lines.english: “Oh, Yamashina. Let me help.”

lines.japanese: 僕が机の上に手を伸ばすと、それまで淡々と作業を進めていた彼女の手がぴたりと止まった。
lines.english: I reached across the desk. Her hands, which had been working away without the slightest fuss, stopped dead.

lines.japanese: 「はねだくん……」
lines.english: “Haneda...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君っ……！」
lines.english: “Haneda...!”

lines.japanese: えっ。
lines.english: Huh?

lines.japanese: 山科さんは机の上に出した僕の手を握ると、それを抱きしめるように自分の胸に押しあてた。
lines.english: Yamashina took the hand I had placed on the desk and hugged it tight against her chest.

lines.japanese: 制服の上から触れた彼女の胸の柔らかさに、教室という聖域であるにも関わらず、僕のふしだらさが刺激された。
lines.english: Even through her uniform, the softness beneath my hand stirred something indecent in me—here, in the sacred precincts of the classroom.

lines.japanese: 「ど、どうしたの山科さん」
lines.english: “Wh-what’s wrong, Yamashina?”

lines.japanese: 「私っ、ずっと我慢してて……っ」
lines.english: “I've been holding it in this whole time...!”

lines.japanese: 「ほんとは二人でずっと、ずうっと居たかったけど、約束したから我慢してたんだ……羽田君が話しかけてくれたのに、事務的な対応してごめんね。本当は凄く嬉しくて、動揺してたんだよ」
lines.english: “The truth is, I wanted to be alone with you all day—every last minute of it. But I promised, so I made myself behave... I'm sorry I was so businesslike when you tried to talk to me. I was really so happy I didn't know what to do with myself.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい、気を悪くしないで、お願い。だけど昨日の約束を破ったら二度と口きいてもらえないと思って、そんなことになったら私生きていけないから、とにかく怖かったの」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. Please don't be upset with me. But I thought that if I broke yesterday's promise, you might never speak to me again—and if that happened, I couldn't go on living. I was just so scared.”

lines.japanese: 「朝だって、羽田君が来るまでもＧＡＢＡが大量放出されてたのに、顔を見た瞬間限界に達して、私もうおかしくなっちゃうんじゃないかって思って……」
lines.english: “Even this morning, while I was waiting for you, my brain was pumping out GABA by the gallon. Then the instant I saw your face, I hit my limit. I thought I was going to lose my mind...”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ、ありがとう」
lines.english: “I see. Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 彼女は昨日、僕とした約束をずっと守っていてくれたんだ。なんて健気な女の子だろう。
lines.english: All this time, she had been keeping the promise she made me yesterday. What a brave, devoted girl.

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫。制服の上からでも胸の鼓動が伝わってきて、おれの手の平に山科さんのいまの気持ちを教えてくれるよ」
lines.english: “It's all right. Even through your uniform, I can feel your heart beating. It's telling the palm of my hand exactly how you feel.”

lines.japanese: 僕は彼女の鼓動を少しでも強く感じたくて、あてがわれた手に力を込めた。
lines.english: Wanting to feel that heartbeat even more clearly, I pressed the hand she held against herself a little harder.

lines.japanese: 「うん……羽田君の手の感触が伝わってきて、嬉しい……」
lines.english: “Mm... I can feel your hand against me. I'm so happy...”

lines.japanese: 「そこまで言われちゃうと、ちょっと恥ずかしいな」
lines.english: “When you put it like that, it's kind of embarrassing.”

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめんね、私も恥ずかしいけど……恥ずかしいのに、こうやって言わないと我慢できなくて、おかしくなっちゃいそうなくらい変なの。好きなの。もう、気持ちが溢れて止まらないの」
lines.english: “S-sorry. I'm embarrassed too... but even though I'm embarrassed, I can't bear to keep it in. I'm so strange I feel like I'm losing my mind. I love you. My feelings are spilling over, and I can't stop them anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「ほんとは今だって、恥ずかしくて逃げだしたいくらいなのに、羽田君と一緒に居たくて仕方ないの。羽田君のことが好きなの……」
lines.english: “Even now, I'm so embarrassed I could run away... but I can't bear not to be with you. I love you, Haneda...”

lines.japanese: 僕の手を体の一部に埋めこもうとするみたいに強く抱きしめる山科さん。彼女は言葉通り、どこか幸せそうに、なのに切なそうに、愛執と哀愁をたたえた目で僕を見上げた。
lines.english: Yamashina clutched my hand so tightly it was as if she meant to draw it inside herself. True to her words, she looked happy somehow, and yet heartsick; she gazed up at me with eyes full of obsessive love and melancholy.

lines.japanese: 「私、重い……のかな」
lines.english: “Am I... too much?”

lines.japanese: そして、自反するように、それでも懇願するように呟いた。
lines.english: She whispered it as if rebuking herself, and yet pleading with me all the same.

lines.japanese: 「そんなことないよ。重いって、どういうこと？」
lines.english: “Not at all. What do you mean, too much?”

lines.japanese: 「だから、羽田君にとってはそこまでのことじゃないっていうか……」
lines.english: “I mean... maybe none of this means as much to you as it does to me...”

lines.japanese: 「だって、おれは山科さんの恋人だから。好きだって言ってもらえるのはうれしいよ」
lines.english: “But I'm your boyfriend. Of course I'm happy when you tell me you love me.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんね、おれがもっと積極的だったらいいんだけど、そういうのってどうすればいいのか分からなくて。おれ、女の子と付きあうのって始めてだから」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. I wish I could take the lead more, but I don't know what I'm supposed to do. I've never gone out with a girl before.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、私が……初めてなんだ」
lines.english: “Oh... So I'm your first.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そうだよ。山科さんだけだよ」
lines.english: “Yeah. You're the only one.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、私が最初で最後のひとなんだ……ふふっ、すごく嬉しい。じゃあ私、羽田君にとって、世界で一番の女の子になれるといいな」
lines.english: “Then I'm your first and your last... Hee hee. That makes me so happy. I hope I can become the best girl in the whole world for you.”

lines.japanese: 「え、どうして？　だって、今だって山科さんが一番好きだよ」
lines.english: “Huh? Why? You're already the girl I love more than anyone.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、羽田君が恋愛相手を私しか知らなくても後悔しないように、ずっと一番で、たった一人のひとでありたい」
lines.english: “No. Even if I’m the only girl you ever date, I don’t want you to regret it. I want to be your number one for life—your one and only.”

lines.japanese: なんだか、さっきから一番とか一生とか、一が付く単語が多いなあ。これだけ一途に好きだと言ってくれるのは嬉しいけど、まるで僕と結婚するみたいだ。
lines.english: Number one for life. One and only. She kept finding new ways to say one. I was happy she loved me so single-mindedly, but she sounded almost as if she meant to marry me.

lines.japanese: 「うん、そうなってくれると嬉しいよ」
lines.english: “Yeah. I'd be happy if you did.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふ、頑張ります」
lines.english: “Hee hee. I'll do my best.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんは、僕の手を持ちあげて自分の胸から離すと、顔の前で押しいただくように両手で握りしめた。
lines.english: Yamashina lifted my hand away from her chest, then clasped it between both of hers before her face as if in worship.

lines.japanese: 「だって、言ったじゃない。山科さんのことは何でも受けいれるって」
lines.english: “I told you, didn't I? I'll accept everything about you.”

lines.japanese: 彼女は真っ赤だった顔を俯かせて、急に黙りこんだ。何だろう、おかしなこと言っちゃったのかも。
lines.english: She lowered her scarlet face and suddenly fell silent. What was wrong? Maybe I had said something strange.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの？」
lines.english: “What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、実は、ね……今日早起きして、羽田君のために作ったものがあるの」
lines.english: “Um, yes. The truth is... I got up early today and made something for you.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、おれに？　なに、なにを作ってくれたの？」
lines.english: “For me? What? What did you make?”

lines.japanese: 「あの、羽田君が、本当に私のこと何でも受けいれてくれるって約束したら……」
lines.english: “Um... if you promise you'll really accept everything about me...”

lines.japanese: 「その、渡せると思う」
lines.english: “Then... I think I can give it to you.”

lines.japanese: 何だ、そんなこと何度も言ってるのに。僕は彼女の奥ゆかしさがちょっと歯がゆかったけど、それがまたおかしみを含んでいて、顔が自然にほころんでしまった。
lines.english: But I had told her that over and over. Her reserve was a little frustrating, but there was something endearing about it too, and I felt my face soften into a smile.

lines.japanese: 「受けいれるよ。約束する」
lines.english: “I will. I promise.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君……うん、信じる……ありがとう、今の私の嬉しさ分かるかな……受けいれてもらえる喜びは、何物にも代えがたい幸せの福音だよ」
lines.english: “Haneda... All right. I believe you... Thank you. I wonder if you can understand how happy I am right now... The joy of being accepted is a gospel of happiness beyond compare.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、何を作ったのか見せてもらってもいいかな」
lines.english: “Then may I see what you made?”

lines.japanese: 「うん……お願いだから、期待なんてしないでね。本当に大したものじゃないから」
lines.english: “Yes... But please, don't get your hopes up. It really isn't anything special.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんは自分の席に戻って鞄を開くと、幾度かの逡巡を見せた。しかしやがて、両腕を交差させた中にそれを抱くと、おずおずと僕のもとに戻ってくる。
lines.english: Yamashina returned to her seat and opened her bag, only to hesitate again and again. At last, cradling it within her crossed arms, she made her timid way back to me.

lines.japanese: 「あの、これ……」
lines.english: “Um... This...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 僕は一瞬、戸惑った。これは、お弁当……何だろうけど……。
lines.english: For a moment, I did not know what to make of it. This was... a boxed lunch. At least, I thought it was.

lines.japanese: 窓のある方を振りかえった。そこからは、黄昏を迎える前の、オレンジ色の光が降りそそいでいる。
lines.english: I glanced back toward the windows. Orange light, not yet deepened into twilight, came pouring through them.

lines.japanese: もしかして食べ残し？　じゃないよね。だって、弁当箱のなかはきちんと埋めつくされているから。
lines.english: Could it be leftovers? No, that couldn't be right. The lunch box was still neatly filled from edge to edge.

lines.japanese: 「あ、これは……」
lines.english: “Oh. This is...”

lines.japanese: 「こ、こんな時間に出されても困るよね。これ、今朝、早起きして作ったんだけど……」
lines.english: “I-it must be a nuisance, getting this so late. I woke up early and made it this morning, but...”

lines.japanese: 「あっ」
lines.english: “Ah!”

lines.japanese: 僕は今朝の教室を思いだした。いつもより早く来たつもりだったのに、山科さんはすでに席に着いていた。
lines.english: I remembered the classroom that morning. I had thought I was early, but Yamashina had already been sitting at her desk.

lines.japanese: それは僕のためだったんだ。渡来さんのことといい、最近弁当づいてるなあ。
lines.english: So that was why. She had come early for me. First Watarai, now this—I seemed to be enjoying a sudden golden age of boxed lunches.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのこれ、良かったら、でいいんだけど……こんな時間だし、捨てちゃっても構わないから。あ、でも、出来れば私の見てないところで捨てて」
lines.english: “Um... You only have to take it if you want to. It's so late already, you can throw it away if you like. Oh, but... if you do, please wait until I'm not looking.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことするわけないよ！　でも、どうしてこんな時間になったの？　おれ、今日もパン食だったから、山科さんのお弁当食べたかったよ」
lines.english: “I would never do that! But why did you wait until now? I only had bread for lunch today. I would've loved to eat yours.”

lines.japanese: 僕は両手を振りながら、彼女のネガティブな想像を打ちけした。せっかく作ってくれたものを捨てるなんて、例えお腹がいっぱいだとしてもするわけがない。
lines.english: I waved both hands, trying to banish the grim picture in her head. Throw away something she had gone to all this trouble to make for me? I wouldn't do that even if I were already stuffed.

lines.japanese: 「だ、だって、見てわかるでしょ？　出来が悪くて、味だって自信がないから……料理なんてしたことないし、恥ずかしくて……」
lines.english: “B-but you can tell just by looking, can't you? It came out so badly, and I don't know if it even tastes good... I've never cooked before. I was too embarrassed...”

lines.japanese: 「今だって、羽田君の優しさに甘えなければよかったって、そこの窓から飛んで落ちちゃいたいくらいだよ……」
lines.english: “Even now, I wish I hadn't taken advantage of your kindness. I'm so ashamed I want to jump out that window...”

lines.japanese: 「だ、駄目だよ、そんなことしちゃ。そんなに恥ずかしいの？」
lines.english: “D-don't! You can't do that. Is it really that embarrassing?”

lines.japanese: こくこくと彼女は必死にうなずいた。まあその……出来が悪いというか、確かに渡来さんと比べたりすると、明らかに未経験らしい部分は随所に見られるけど、それはだって、仕方のないことであって……。
lines.english: She nodded frantically, over and over. Well... badly made wasn’t quite how I would put it. Compared with Watarai’s cooking, there were certainly signs of inexperience everywhere. But that was only natural...

lines.japanese: 「こんな出来のものを見せたら、羽田君に嫌われるんじゃないかって心配だったの。料理が出来ない女の子だって嫌われちゃったらどうしようって思って……」
lines.english: “I was afraid you'd hate me if I showed you something like this. I kept thinking, what if you hate girls who can't cook...”

lines.japanese: 「でも、これから頑張って練習するから……今日はどうしても、昨日の夜から羽田君のことを考えてたせいで我慢出来なくなっちゃって……」
lines.english: “But I'll practice hard from now on... Today I just couldn't help myself. I'd been thinking about you ever since last night...”

lines.japanese: 「でも、やっぱり、喜んで欲しくて……」
lines.english: “And still... I wanted so badly to make you happy...”

lines.japanese: 最後の声は擦りきれそうなくらいにか細かった。それだけで彼女がどれだけ必死な想いで作ってくれたかがよく分かる。
lines.english: Her last words were so faint they seemed ready to fray away altogether. That alone told me how desperately she had poured her heart into making this.

lines.japanese: 喜ぶなんてものじゃなくて、今の気持ちを言葉にしたらそんな単語一つじゃ表現できない。だから僕は、たった一言で千万の単語を表すことにした。
lines.english: Happy did not begin to cover it. If I tried to put what I felt into words, that one little word could never hold it all. So I decided to make a single phrase stand in for ten million words.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんが、生まれかわったようにぱあっと笑顔を輝かせる。
lines.english: Yamashina's face lit up as though she had been born anew.

lines.japanese: 「あ、ありがとう……受けとって……くれるの？」
lines.english: “Th-thank you... You'll take it?”

lines.japanese: 「当たり前だよ。山科さんがおれのために作ってくれたんだから、どんなにお腹いっぱいでも食べるよ」
lines.english: “Of course. You made it for me. I'd eat it no matter how full I was.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう……ありがとう、羽田君」
lines.english: “Thank you... Thank you, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「なに言ってるの。お礼を言うのはおれの方なんだから」
lines.english: “What are you talking about? I'm the one who should be thanking you.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、食べてみていいかな」
lines.english: “Oh—may I try it now?”

lines.japanese: 「で、でも、食べて味が悪かったら、私のこと嫌いにならないかな……」
lines.english: “B-but if it tastes bad, you won't start hating me... will you?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことで嫌わないよ」
lines.english: “I would never hate you for that.”

lines.japanese: 「本当？　本当に私を捨てない？　信じていいの？」
lines.english: “Really? You truly won't abandon me? I can believe you?”

lines.japanese: 僕は箸をとって、少し水っ気のあるごはんを口に運んだ。ちょっとねちゃっとして、まるで昔食べた、レトルト食品のごはんみたいだったけど、乾いた冬にはちょうどいい。
lines.english: I picked up the chopsticks and brought some of the rather watery rice to my mouth. It was a little gluey, like the precooked rice I remembered eating years ago, but in the dry winter air it was just right.

lines.japanese: 「ほら、大好きだよ」
lines.english: “See? I love you.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君……」
lines.english: “Haneda...”

lines.japanese: 僕が口にまだごはんを残したまま微笑みかけると、山科さんは目に涙を浮かべて喜んでくれた。
lines.english: I smiled at her with rice still in my mouth, and tears of joy sprang into Yamashina's eyes.

lines.japanese: はは、喜んでるのは僕なのに、作ってくれた山科さんが涙を浮かべるなんて、不思議な話。
lines.english: Ha ha. I was the happy one, yet the girl who had made the lunch was tearing up. Funny how that worked.

lines.japanese: さあ次は生野菜だ。僕の嫌いな青臭いキュウリが入っていたけど、このお米とは合うかもしれない。
lines.english: Next came the raw vegetables. There was cucumber in there—that grassy flavor I hated—but perhaps it would go well with the rice.

lines.japanese: 今度、小鳩にお米の炊き方を教えてもらおう。口の中で何度も咀嚼しながら、おかずとともに水っぽいごはんを平らげた。
lines.english: I would have to ask Kobato to teach me how to cook rice sometime. Chewing every mouthful thoroughly, I polished off the watery rice along with all the side dishes.

lines.japanese: もうすぐ日が落ちるころ。巣に向かう鳥の姿は見えないけれど、静かな校舎の澄み渡った空気を衒いなく好きだと言える。
lines.english: The sun would soon be down. I saw no birds winging home to their nests, but I could say without the least affectation that I loved the clear air of the silent school building.

lines.japanese: そんなふうに風景を美しく感じるのは、山科さんがずっと僕に優しい微笑みを向けているからだろう。
lines.english: Maybe the world looked so beautiful because Yamashina had been smiling gently at me all this time.

lines.japanese: 「全部食べてくれてありがとう。きっとこれも羽田君の優しさだよね」
lines.english: “Thank you for eating every last bite. I suppose that was another kindness from you.”

lines.japanese: 「優しさ？　えっ、どういうこと？」
lines.english: “My kindness? What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「だって、こんな時間にお腹空いてたなんてことないよね？　きっと無理して食べてくれたんだよね、しかもおいしいって何度も言ってくれて……」
lines.english: “You couldn't really have been hungry this late, could you? You forced yourself to eat it, and you even kept telling me how good it was...”

lines.japanese: 「その優しさが嬉しくてなにも言わなかったけど、ほんとのことは分かってるから。ありがとう、羽田君。大好き」
lines.english: “Your kindness made me so happy that I didn't say anything, but I know the truth. Thank you, Haneda. I love you.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことないよ。そろそろお腹も空いてきたなって思ってたんだ、おいしかったよ」
lines.english: “That's not true. I was just starting to get hungry, and it really was good.”

lines.japanese: 僕がお礼を言うと、山科さんは机の上に置いた手を上げてふるふると横に振った。
lines.english: When I thanked her, Yamashina lifted the hand resting on the desk and waved it gently from side to side.

lines.japanese: 「いいよ、そこまで言わなくてもいいの。分かってるから、もう言わないで。だけどその一つ一つの優しさが心から嬉しいよ。ふふっ」
lines.english: “It's all right. You don't have to keep saying it. I understand, so please, no more. But every one of those little kindnesses makes me happy from the bottom of my heart. Hee hee.”

lines.japanese: もう言わないでって言われちゃったけど、本当にお腹が空いてたんだけどな。
lines.english: She had told me to stop, but I really had been hungry.

lines.japanese: 「私が作ったもの全部、羽田君を形作る要素に変わっていくんだね、きっと」
lines.english: “Everything I made is going to become part of what makes you who you are, isn’t it?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そういうことになるかな」
lines.english: “Yeah. I suppose it is.”

lines.japanese: ちょっと大げさな表現に僕はくすりと笑いながら答えた。
lines.english: I answered with a quiet laugh at her slightly grandiose phrasing.

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ、何がおかしいの？」
lines.english: “Hee hee. What is so funny?”

lines.japanese: そんな僕の笑いに釣られたのか、山科さんも微笑んだ。夕焼けに染まる教室、なんだかとても胸に染みる風景だ。
lines.english: Perhaps my laughter was infectious, because Yamashina smiled too. The classroom lay steeped in sunset. Somehow, the sight went straight to my heart.

lines.japanese: さて、じゃあ用事も済んだし帰ろうかな。
lines.english: Well, that was everything taken care of. I supposed it was time to head home.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、昇降口行こうか」
lines.english: “Shall we go down to the entrance?”
